objects._comment: Malware object enriched from MITRE ATT&CK taxonomy. x_mitre_platforms comes directly from the loaded ATT&CK STIX (look up by name in load_mitre_taxonomy()['malware']). NO hardcoded mapping.
objects.name: BlackCat
objects.description: Rust-based ransomware operated by an affiliate group; cross-platform (Windows and Linux) with ESXi-targeting variants. Performs lateral movement via PsExec and harvested credentials; encrypts files with AES + ChaCha20.

objects._comment: Identity for the targeted victim organization class. identity_class from STIX open vocab 'identity-class-ov'.
objects.name: Targeted enterprise organization
objects.description: BlackCat campaigns observed against multiple sectors. Sectors derived from STIX open vocab 'industry-sector-ov' by looking up sector keywords in the source text against the vocab.

objects._comment: Infrastructure object 1: the Windows domain controller. infrastructure_types from STIX 2.1 'infrastructure-type-ov'. Derived from IR observation that the malware uses PsExec + harvested AD credentials + lateral movement (T1003.006 DCSync), implying an AD environment.
objects.name: Windows Domain Controller
objects.description: Domain controller for the targeted enterprise AD forest. Presence inferred from IR techniques T1003.006 (DCSync), T1558 (Kerberoasting), T1078.002 (Domain Accounts).

objects._comment: Infrastructure 2: domain-joined workstation. infrastructure_types: 'workstation' is in STIX open vocab.
objects.name: Domain-joined Windows workstation
objects.description: End-user host on the AD domain. Primary encryption target. Derived from IR techniques T1486 (Data Encrypted for Impact), T1490 (Inhibit System Recovery).

objects._comment: Infrastructure 3: the Exchange server is a literal mention in the IR ('Unpatched Exchange server'). Mapped to STIX vocab 'hosting-malware' because BlackCat uses it as an initial-access foothold + sometimes as a staging host. Could also be 'unknown'.
objects.name: Internet-facing Microsoft Exchange server
objects.description: Unpatched Exchange server exploited for initial access (CVE-2021-26855 ProxyLogon chain or similar).

objects._comment: Relationship edges. Every relationship_type is from STIX 2.1 'relationship-type-ov' (e.g., 'targets', 'uses', 'compromises', 'communicates-with'). NO custom verbs.

objects.description: Workstation is domain-joined to the DC.
